# Gertie Pye

## Personality

Gertie Pye is known for her dishonest behavior, earning a reputation among her peers as a cheat. She also has a habit of constantly squeaking her pencil, a sound that deeply irritates others.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026), [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018)_

## History

Gertie Pye is a student who attends the local school alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). She is part of the peer group that dresses in modern fashions, such as dresses with puffed sleeves, which sets a standard of style among the schoolgirls. During the local Christmas concert, she participates alongside her classmates in an event that turns out to be a tremendous success.
